title: Sepher ha-Zohar, Le Livre de la Splendeur Vol. 3 (French, Pauly trans. 1908)
author: Jean de Pauly
description: The third volume of Jean de Pauly's French translation of the Zohar. Its mystical readings of scripture explore divine attributes, creation and the spiritual meanings embedded in the Torah.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (EPUB from PDF). Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/SepherHaZoharLeLivre3).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
